ar.imagery.name: Arkansas Imagery Archive
ar.imagery.summary: Statewide aerial imagery from the Arkansas GIS Office, one service per flight.

aws.terrain-tiles.name: Terrain Tiles (terrarium)
aws.terrain-tiles.summary: Global elevation packed into RGB tiles, aggregated from SRTM, USGS 3DEP, GMTED2010 and other public sources. Used for hillshading and for elevation outside the United States.
aws.terrain-tiles.attribution: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data — data from USGS, NASA, NGA and other public sources

blm.cadnsdi.plss.name: Public Land Survey System (CadNSDI)
blm.cadnsdi.plss.summary: The township, range and section grid of the Public Land Survey System, with quarter-quarter sections and government lots, compiled from BLM cadastral survey records for the thirty public-land states.
blm.cadnsdi.plss.attribution: PLSS courtesy of the Bureau of Land Management, CadNSDI

census.tigerweb.aiannha.name: TIGERweb American Indian, Alaska Native and Native Hawaiian Areas
census.tigerweb.aiannha.summary: Federal and state reservations, off-reservation trust lands, Alaska Native Regional Corporations and Hawaiian Home Lands.
census.tigerweb.aiannha.attribution: American Indian, Alaska Native and Native Hawaiian areas courtesy of the U.S. Census Bureau

census.tigerweb.legislative.name: TIGERweb Legislative Districts
census.tigerweb.legislative.summary: Current congressional districts and upper and lower state legislative districts from the Census Bureau's TIGER database.
census.tigerweb.legislative.attribution: Legislative districts courtesy of the U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line database

census.tigerweb.school.name: TIGERweb School Districts
census.tigerweb.school.summary: Unified, elementary and secondary school district boundaries as reported to the Census Bureau by state education officials.
census.tigerweb.school.attribution: School districts courtesy of the U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line database

census.tigerweb.tracts.history.name: TIGERweb census tracts, by decennial census
census.tigerweb.tracts.history.summary: Census tract boundaries as drawn for the 2010 and 2020 censuses. Tracts are redrawn every ten years to hold around four thousand people each, so the change shows where population grew or fell.

census.tigerweb.zcta.name: TIGERweb ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
census.tigerweb.zcta.summary: The Census Bureau's areal approximations of USPS ZIP Code service areas. ZIP Codes themselves are mail routes rather than areas, so these are the nearest thing to ZIP boundaries that is published nationally.
census.tigerweb.zcta.attribution: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas courtesy of the U.S. Census Bureau

ct.imagery.name: Connecticut Imagery Archive
ct.imagery.summary: Statewide orthophotography and NAIP from Connecticut Environmental Conditions Online.

dc.imagery.name: DC Orthophoto Archive
dc.imagery.summary: The District of Columbia's orthophotography. Most years are CC BY 4.0, and 2013 and 2015 carry their own terms.
dc.imagery.attribution: District of Columbia, Office of the Chief Technology Officer

de.imagery.name: Delaware FirstMap Imagery
de.imagery.summary: Delaware's aerial photographs from 1926 on. The historical years are public domain, with credit to the Delaware Archives, the National Archives and the Agricultural Stabilization and Conservation Service; the modern years state no use constraints.
de.imagery.attribution: Delaware FirstMap; Delaware Public Archives; National Archives; USDA ASCS

eox.s2cloudless.name: Sentinel-2 cloudless
eox.s2cloudless.summary: A cloud-free global satellite mosaic assembled from ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery.
eox.s2cloudless.attribution: Sentinel-2 cloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH, contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data

esri.wayback.name: World Imagery Wayback
esri.wayback.summary: Every published version of Esri's World Imagery basemap since 2014. Dates are the day each picture was captured, which differ from place to place.
esri.wayback.attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community

useStatus.restricted: Esri's terms for Wayback and Living Atlas content appear to bar a paid app that is not an Esri customer. Needs Esri's written confirmation.

faa.ifr.high.name: FAA IFR Enroute High Altitude Charts
faa.ifr.high.summary: The FAA's charts for instrument flight at 18,000 ft and above: jet routes, navaids, waypoints and air route traffic control centre boundaries. Reissued every 56 days.
faa.ifr.high.attribution: Federal Aviation Administration, Aeronautical Information Services

faa.ifr.low.name: FAA IFR Enroute Low Altitude and Area Charts
faa.ifr.low.summary: The FAA's charts for instrument flight below 18,000 ft: Victor airways, minimum altitudes, navaids, waypoints and airports with instrument approaches, with larger-scale area charts around busy terminals. Reissued every 56 days.
faa.ifr.low.attribution: Federal Aviation Administration, Aeronautical Information Services

faa.vfr.sectional.name: FAA VFR Sectional Charts
faa.vfr.sectional.summary: The FAA's 1:500,000 charts for visual flight: airports, airspace, navaids, obstacles, terrain and visual landmarks, seamlessly mosaicked across the United States. Reissued every 56 days.
faa.vfr.sectional.attribution: Federal Aviation Administration, Aeronautical Information Services

faa.vfr.terminal.name: FAA VFR Terminal Area Charts
faa.vfr.terminal.summary: The FAA's 1:250,000 charts of the airspace around the busiest U.S. airports, with the same symbols as the sectionals at twice the scale. Reissued every 56 days.
faa.vfr.terminal.attribution: Federal Aviation Administration, Aeronautical Information Services

fl.imagery.name: Florida DEP Aerial Imagery
fl.imagery.summary: Florida Department of Transportation aerial photography and older countywide photographs, served by the Department of Environmental Protection. FREAC asks to be acknowledged.

ga.imagery.name: Georgia GIS Clearinghouse Imagery
ga.imagery.summary: Orthophoto quadrangles, colour infrared and FSA photography of Georgia, served by the University of Georgia's ITOS. The service states no access constraints.

gebco.latest.name: GEBCO Global Grid
gebco.latest.summary: The international reference bathymetric grid covering every ocean, produced under the IHO and IOC.
gebco.latest.attribution: Imagery reproduced from the GEBCO Grid, GEBCO Compilation Group

iastate.ortho.name: Iowa Statewide Orthoimagery Archive
iastate.ortho.summary: Iowa's aerial photography archive, from scanned 1930s photographs through the modern NAIP series.
iastate.ortho.attribution: Historical orthoimagery courtesy of the Iowa State University GIS Facility

id.imagery.name: Idaho NAIP Archive
id.imagery.summary: Every NAIP flight over Idaho since 2004, served by INSIDE Idaho at the University of Idaho Library. The service describes it as public data.
id.imagery.attribution: INSIDE Idaho, University of Idaho Library; USDA FSA Aerial Photography Field Office

il.imagery.name: Illinois Geospatial Data Clearinghouse Imagery
il.imagery.summary: NAPP orthophoto quadrangles and NAIP served by the Illinois State Geological Survey.

useStatus.restricted: The ISGS states its data is copyrighted by the University of Illinois with all rights reserved, and that a licence and fees may be required depending on use. Needs the Survey's written agreement for a paid app.

in.imagery.name: Indiana Orthoimagery
in.imagery.summary: Orthoimagery from the Indiana Geographic Information Office, published under CC0.

inland.bathymetry.aggregate.name: Inland Water Depth (combined surveys)
inland.bathymetry.aggregate.summary: Surveyed depth of inland water, assembled from every public agency that publishes it as a map service: the Minnesota DNR, the Ohio DNR, MassWildlife and MassGIS, the North Dakota GIS Hub and Game and Fish Department, the Great Lakes Commission, and NOAA's National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science. No single agency surveys the nation's lakes, so coverage is the union of what these programmes have measured — dense in the states that run lake survey programmes, absent in those that do not.
inland.bathymetry.aggregate.attribution: Inland depth surveys courtesy of the Minnesota DNR, Ohio DNR, MassWildlife/MassGIS, North Dakota GIS Hub, the Great Lakes Commission and NOAA NCCOS

ks.imagery.name: Kansas Statewide Imagery
ks.imagery.summary: USGS orthophoto quadrangles, NAIP and the state's NG911 flights, served by the Kansas Geological Survey for DASC.
ks.imagery.attribution: Kansas DASC; USDA FSA NAIP; USGS

ky.imagery.name: KyFromAbove Imagery
ky.imagery.summary: USGS orthophoto quadrangles, NAIP and the state's own leaf-off KyFromAbove flights, which the Commonwealth distributes in the public domain.
ky.imagery.attribution: Kentucky Division of Geographic Information; USDA FSA NAIP

la.imagery.name: LSU Atlas Imagery
la.imagery.summary: Orthophoto quadrangles and statewide six-inch imagery published by LSU Atlas, which asks that its data be credited.

ma.imagery.name: MassGIS Orthoimagery
ma.imagery.summary: MassGIS's statewide orthophotography. No restrictions apply to its own years, and MassGIS asks to be acknowledged.
ma.imagery.attribution: MassGIS (Bureau of Geographic Information), Commonwealth of Massachusetts EOTSS

macrostrat.carto.name: Macrostrat Geologic Map
macrostrat.carto.summary: A harmonised global geologic map assembled from national, state and regional surveys, carrying formation names, lithology and interval ages for each mapped unit.
macrostrat.carto.attribution: Geologic map data from Macrostrat (CC BY 4.0), compiled from national and regional geological surveys

md.imagery.name: MD iMAP Imagery
md.imagery.summary: Orthophoto quadrangles, NAIP and the state's six-inch imagery programme, served by MD iMAP.

mi.imagery.name: Michigan Imagery Solution
mi.imagery.summary: NAPP and NAIP over Michigan, and the state's own 2024 flight of the Lower Peninsula.
mi.imagery.attribution: State of Michigan DTMB; USDA FSA NAIP

mn.imagery.name: Minnesota Imagery Archive
mn.imagery.summary: Statewide aerial imagery served by MnGeo.
mn.imagery.attribution: Minnesota IT Services, Geospatial Information Office

mndnr.lakebathy.relief.name: Minnesota Lake Bathymetric Shaded Relief
mndnr.lakebathy.relief.summary: Minnesota's lake-bed elevation model rendered as colour-shaded relief, from pale shallows through to deep blue basins.
mndnr.lakebathy.relief.attribution: Lake bathymetry courtesy of the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

mo.imagery.name: MSDIS Imagery
mo.imagery.summary: Statewide orthophotography and NAIP served by the Missouri Spatial Data Information Service.

ms.imagery.name: MARIS Imagery
ms.imagery.summary: NAIP over Mississippi, including the 30 cm emergency collection of autumn 2021, served by MARIS.

mt.imagery.name: Montana Imagery Archive
mt.imagery.summary: USGS orthophoto quadrangles of the 1990s and every NAIP flight since 2005, served by the Montana State Library.
mt.imagery.attribution: Montana State Library; USDA FSA NAIP

nasa.gibs.landsat-weld.name: Landsat Web-Enabled Landsat Data (WELD) annual mosaics
nasa.gibs.landsat-weld.summary: Cloud-free yearly mosaics of Landsat imagery at 30 m for the years around 1985, 1990 and 2000. Served by NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services.
nasa.gibs.landsat-weld.attribution: Landsat WELD imagery from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS)

nasa.gibs.modis-terra.name: MODIS Terra Corrected Reflectance (True Color)
nasa.gibs.modis-terra.summary: A picture of the whole Earth every day since February 2000, at 250 m, from the MODIS instrument on NASA's Terra satellite. Served by NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services.
nasa.gibs.modis-terra.attribution: Imagery from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)

nc.imagery.name: NC OneMap Orthoimagery
nc.imagery.summary: USGS orthophoto quadrangles of the 1990s and the state's own six-inch orthoimagery, flown in four-year cycles.
nc.imagery.attribution: NC OneMap; NC Center for Geographic Information and Analysis; NC 911 Board

nd.imagery.name: North Dakota Aerial Imagery
nd.imagery.summary: USDA photography of 1957–1962, USGS orthophoto quadrangles of the 1990s and every NAIP flight since 2003. The publisher states no constraints on use.
nd.imagery.attribution: USDA FSA Aerial Photography Field Office; North Dakota GIS Hub

nh.imagery.name: NH GRANIT Orthophotography
nh.imagery.summary: Orthophoto quadrangles, NAIP and the state's own one-foot and six-inch flights, served by NH GRANIT.

nj.imagery.name: NJGIN Imagery
nj.imagery.summary: New Jersey's orthophotography and NAIP, with coastal surveys of 1920, 1970 and 1977, published by the NJ Office of GIS, which asks to be acknowledged.
nj.imagery.attribution: NJ Office of Information Technology, Office of GIS (NJOGIS)

noaa.enc.name: NOAA Electronic Navigational Charts
noaa.enc.summary: Surveyed depth contours, depth areas and spot soundings from NOAA's official electronic navigational charts. Covers coastal waters, the Great Lakes and navigable rivers — the waters NOAA charts for navigation.
noaa.enc.attribution: Nautical chart data courtesy of NOAA Office of Coast Survey

noaa.multibeam.name: NOAA Multibeam Bathymetry Mosaic
noaa.multibeam.summary: High-resolution sea-floor topography assembled from multibeam sonar surveys held by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information. Coverage follows ship tracks, so it is detailed where surveys exist and absent elsewhere.
noaa.multibeam.attribution: Multibeam bathymetry courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

noaa.ngs.eri.name: Emergency Response Imagery
noaa.ngs.eri.summary: Aerial photographs NOAA's National Geodetic Survey flies over the coast and inland in the days after a hurricane or other disaster. Not for use in litigation.

ny.imagery.name: NYS Orthoimagery
ny.imagery.summary: New York's orthoimagery programme and the statewide NAPP and NAIP flights, published at no cost by NYS ITS Geospatial Services.
ny.imagery.attribution: NYS ITS Geospatial Services; USGS; USDA

nyc.imagery.name: NYC Orthoimagery
nyc.imagery.summary: The City of New York's aerial photographs, licensed for reuse under CC BY 4.0.

ofm.aero.name: open flightmaps VFR Charts
ofm.aero.summary: VFR charts rendered from the open flightmaps database: airspace, aerodromes, navaids, reporting points and obstacles, kept by volunteers for each covered country and updated each AIRAC cycle. Complementary information, not certified for navigation.

useStatus.restricted: The OFMA licence allows commercial use of the data, but this tile server is undocumented; confirm with info@openflightmaps.org before shipping.

oh.imagery.name: Ohio Imagery Archive
oh.imagery.summary: Statewide USGS orthophoto quadrangles and NAIP served by the Ohio Department of Natural Resources. Ohio describes its imagery as available for public use at the user's own risk.

ok.imagery.name: OKMaps NAIP Archive
ok.imagery.summary: Every NAIP flight over Oklahoma since 2008, served by the Oklahoma Office of Geographic Information. The service states no access constraints.
ok.imagery.attribution: Oklahoma Office of Geographic Information; USDA FSA NAIP

openfreemap.liberty.name: OpenFreeMap Liberty
openfreemap.liberty.summary: A global vector basemap built from OpenStreetMap data, served without an API key or usage limit.

oregonexplorer.naip.name: Oregon Imagery Archive
oregonexplorer.naip.summary: Statewide NAIP acquisitions published through Oregon Explorer.

pa.imagery.name: PASDA Imagery
pa.imagery.summary: High-altitude photography of the 1980s, orthophoto quadrangles, PAMAP, PEMA and NAIP, served by PASDA at Penn State.
pa.imagery.attribution: PASDA; PEMA; PAMAP; USDA FSA NAIP

regrid.parcels.name: Regrid Nationwide Parcel Boundaries
regrid.parcels.summary: Tax parcel outlines for every U.S. county, normalised by Regrid from county assessor data. Boundaries only; ownership and assessment attributes are not included.

ri.imagery.name: RIGIS Imagery
ri.imagery.summary: Rhode Island's aerial photographs from 1939, published by RIGIS and the University of Rhode Island Environmental Data Center under CC BY 4.0.
ri.imagery.attribution: RIGIS, University of Rhode Island Environmental Data Center

tx.imagery.name: Texas Imagery Service
tx.imagery.summary: High-altitude photography of 1981, the Texas Orthoimagery Program and NAIP, served by the Texas Geographic Information Office.
tx.imagery.attribution: Texas Geographic Information Office; USDA; USGS

usda.cdl.name: Cropland Data Layer
usda.cdl.summary: A yearly map of which crop was grown where, at 30 m. It reached the whole conterminous United States in 2008, and earlier years cover fewer states.
usda.cdl.attribution: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service Cropland Data Layer

usda.naip.history.name: National Agriculture Imagery Program, by year
usda.naip.history.summary: Leaf-on aerial photography of the conterminous United States, flown state by state every two or three years since 2003, with the 1996–2003 National Aerial Photography Program where it has been published. Served by the U.S. Forest Service for the Geospatial Platform.
usda.naip.history.attribution: USDA Farm Production and Conservation, NAIP; served by USFS GTAC for the Geospatial Platform

usfws.nwi.name: National Wetlands Inventory
usfws.nwi.summary: Classified wetland and deepwater habitats across the United States, following the Cowardin classification system.
usfws.nwi.attribution: National Wetlands Inventory, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

usgs.3dep.name: 3DEP Bare Earth DEM
usgs.3dep.summary: The USGS 3D Elevation Program bare-earth digital elevation model, served dynamically from multi-resolution sources down to 1 metre.
usgs.3dep.attribution: Elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program

usgs.contours.name: USGS Elevation Contours
usgs.contours.summary: Elevation contour lines generated by The National Map from 3DEP elevation data, published at several scales with contour intervals appropriate to each.
usgs.contours.attribution: Contours courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

usgs.higeol.name: Hawaii Geology
usgs.higeol.summary: Geologic map units for the Hawaiian Islands.
usgs.higeol.attribution: Geologic mapping courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

usgs.htmc.name: USGS Historical Topographic Map Collection
usgs.htmc.summary: Scanned USGS topographic maps up to 2006, roughly 180,000 sheets. Which years exist depends entirely on where you are.
usgs.htmc.attribution: Historical topographic maps courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

useStatus.restricted: Esri's terms for Wayback and Living Atlas content appear to bar a paid app that is not an Esri customer. Needs Esri's written confirmation.

usgs.imagery.name: USGS Imagery Only
usgs.imagery.summary: High-resolution orthoimagery for the United States from The National Map.
usgs.imagery.attribution: Imagery courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

usgs.nbd.name: National Boundaries Dataset
usgs.nbd.summary: The National Map's governmental unit boundaries: states, counties, incorporated places, minor civil divisions, tribal areas and federally administered lands.
usgs.nbd.attribution: National Boundaries Dataset courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

usgs.nhd.name: National Hydrography Dataset
usgs.nhd.summary: The authoritative surface-water record for the United States: rivers, streams, canals, lakes, ponds, reservoirs and coastlines, with names and flow relationships.
usgs.nhd.attribution: National Hydrography Dataset courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

usgs.nlcd.annual.name: Annual National Land Cover Database
usgs.nlcd.annual.summary: A yearly map of what covers the ground across the conterminous United States at 30 m, from forest and cropland to developed land.

usgs.padus.name: Protected Areas Database of the United States (PAD-US) 4.1
usgs.padus.summary: The national inventory of public and protected land: federal, state, local and tribal holdings and land owned by nonprofit conservation organisations, coloured by managing agency.
usgs.padus.attribution: PAD-US 4.1, U.S. Geological Survey Gap Analysis Project

usgs.prgeol.name: Puerto Rico Geology
usgs.prgeol.summary: Geologic map units for Puerto Rico.
usgs.prgeol.attribution: Geologic mapping courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

usgs.sgmc.name: State Geologic Map Compilation
usgs.sgmc.summary: The USGS compilation of state geologic maps for the conterminous United States, showing surface geologic units, contacts and structures as published.
usgs.sgmc.attribution: State Geologic Map Compilation courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

usgs.shadedrelief.name: USGS Shaded Relief
usgs.shadedrelief.summary: A shaded relief basemap generated from USGS 3D Elevation Program data.
usgs.shadedrelief.attribution: Shaded relief courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

usgs.topo.name: US Topo
usgs.topo.summary: The current USGS topographic basemap, combining boundaries, hydrography, transportation, contours and geographic names.
usgs.topo.attribution: Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program

usgs.transportation.name: USGS Transportation
usgs.transportation.summary: Roads, trails and railways from The National Map, drawn transparently so they can be laid over imagery.
usgs.transportation.attribution: Transportation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

usgs.wbd.name: Watershed Boundary Dataset
usgs.wbd.summary: Hydrologic unit boundaries from region down to subwatershed, describing how the land drains.
usgs.wbd.attribution: Watershed Boundary Dataset courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

va.imagery.name: Virginia Base Mapping Program
va.imagery.summary: Orthophotography from the Virginia Base Mapping Program. VGIN asks to be credited.
va.imagery.attribution: Virginia Geographic Information Network, Commonwealth of Virginia

vt.imagery.name: VCGI Imagery
vt.imagery.summary: The Vermont Mapping Program's orthophotos from 1974, released into the public domain, and the state's colour imagery since, served by VCGI. The newer services state no use constraints.

wa.imagery.name: Washington State Imagery Archive
wa.imagery.summary: Statewide black-and-white photography of 1989–2000 and NAIP from 2003, served by WaTech for the Washington State Geospatial Program.
wa.imagery.attribution: WaTech, Washington State Geospatial Program; USDA FSA NAIP

wi.imagery.name: Wisconsin DNR Imagery Archive
wi.imagery.summary: NAIP, a 2010 leaf-off flight and georeferenced 1930s photographs, served by the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources.
wi.imagery.attribution: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources; USDA FSA NAIP; State Cartographer's Office

wv.imagery.name: West Virginia Imagery Archive
wv.imagery.summary: The 2003 Statewide Addressing and Mapping Board orthophotography and every NAIP flight since, served by the West Virginia GIS Technical Center.
wv.imagery.attribution: WV GIS Technical Center; USDA FSA NAIP

wy.imagery.name: Wyoming DEQ Imagery
wy.imagery.summary: Statewide black-and-white, colour-infrared and NAIP imagery served by the Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality.
wy.imagery.attribution: Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality; USDA FSA NAIP

layers.name: Contours
layers.summary: Contour lines on a clear background — the layer to use over imagery or geology, since only the lines are drawn.

layers.name: Hillshade
layers.summary: Relief shading computed from global elevation data, showing the shape of the terrain.

layers.name: Topographic Map
layers.summary: The complete USGS topographic sheet. It has an opaque printed background, so lowering its opacity fades the whole sheet rather than revealing what is beneath — for lines over imagery use Contours, or pick Topographic as the base map.

layers.name: Roads & Trails
layers.summary: Roads, trails and railways from The National Map, drawn on a clear background.

layers.name: USGS Shaded Relief
layers.summary: Shaded relief produced by USGS from 3DEP elevation data, at higher quality than the global hillshade but only across the United States.

layers.name: Elevation
layers.summary: 3DEP bare-earth elevation, shaded and tinted by height.

layers.name: Slope
layers.summary: Steepness of the terrain derived from 3DEP elevation.

layers.name: Rivers & Streams
layers.summary: Flowlines from the National Hydrography Dataset — rivers, streams, canals and artificial paths.

layers.name: Lakes & Reservoirs
layers.summary: Waterbody and area features from the National Hydrography Dataset — lakes, ponds, reservoirs, swamps and wide river channels.

layers.name: Watersheds
layers.summary: Hydrologic unit boundaries showing how land drains, from whole regions down to individual subwatersheds.

layers.name: Wetlands
layers.summary: Classified wetland and deepwater habitats from the National Wetlands Inventory.

layers.name: Depth Contours
layers.summary: Surveyed depth contours and spot soundings from NOAA's navigational charts, on a clear background. Covers coastal waters, the Great Lakes and navigable rivers.

layers.name: Nautical Chart
layers.summary: NOAA's navigational chart with full symbology — depth areas, contours, soundings and aids to navigation. Best when zoomed out; use Depth Contours close in.

layers.name: Water Depth
layers.summary: The GEBCO global grid, colour-shaded by depth.

layers.name: Oceanic Bathymetric Shading
layers.summary: Shaded relief of the sea floor from the GEBCO global grid, showing ridges, trenches and canyons.

layers.name: Multibeam Surveys
layers.summary: High-resolution sonar surveys of the sea floor. Detailed where ships have surveyed, absent elsewhere.

layers.name: Inland Water Depth
layers.summary: Surveyed depth contours for lakes, reservoirs and the Great Lakes, combined from every agency that publishes them.

members.attribution: Great Lakes bathymetric contours courtesy of the Great Lakes Commission
Lake Erie bathymetry courtesy of the Ohio Department of Natural Resources
Lake bathymetry courtesy of the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources
Inland lake bathymetry courtesy of the Ohio Department of Natural Resources
Lake contours courtesy of the North Dakota GIS Hub and Game and Fish Department
Inland bathymetry courtesy of MassWildlife and MassGIS

layers.name: Inland Depth Shading
layers.summary: Lake beds as continuously shaded depth rather than lines — pale in the shallows, deep in the basins.

members.attribution: Lake bathymetry courtesy of the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources
Lake Superior bathymetry courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science
Lake Superior multibeam survey courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science
Lake Michigan nearshore bathymetry courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science

layers.name: Surface Geology
layers.summary: Mapped geological units drawn in their published colours.

layers.name: Faults & Contacts
layers.summary: Structural lines from the geologic map — faults, thrusts and the contacts between mapped units.

layers.name: USGS State Geology
layers.summary: Surface geologic units from the USGS State Geologic Map Compilation, as published.

layers.name: Geological Contacts
layers.summary: Boundaries between mapped geologic units.

layers.name: Puerto Rico Geology
layers.summary: Geologic map units for Puerto Rico.

layers.name: Hawaii Geology
layers.summary: Geologic map units for the Hawaiian Islands.

layers.name: States
layers.summary: State and territory boundaries.

layers.name: Counties
layers.summary: County and county-equivalent boundaries, including parishes, boroughs and independent cities.

layers.name: Cities & Towns
layers.summary: Limits of incorporated cities, towns, villages and boroughs.

layers.name: Townships
layers.summary: Minor civil divisions — townships, towns and similar county subdivisions that act as local government in the Northeast and Midwest.

layers.name: Federal Lands
layers.summary: Land administered by federal agencies — the Park Service, Forest Service, BLM, Fish and Wildlife Service and the military — coloured by agency.

layers.name: Congressional Districts
layers.summary: U.S. House districts for the current Congress.

layers.name: State Senate Districts
layers.summary: Upper-chamber state legislative districts. Nebraska's unicameral legislature appears here.

layers.name: State House Districts
layers.summary: Lower-chamber state legislative districts — the state house or assembly.

layers.name: School Districts
layers.summary: Unified, elementary and secondary public school district boundaries.

layers.name: ZIP Codes
layers.summary: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas — the Census Bureau's area approximations of ZIP Code delivery areas.

layers.name: Tribal Lands
layers.summary: Reservations, off-reservation trust land, Alaska Native Regional Corporations and Hawaiian Home Lands.

layers.name: Census Tracts by Census
layers.summary: Census tract boundaries from the 2010 and 2020 censuses. A tract that split in two gained people; two that merged lost them.

layers.name: Public & Protected Lands
layers.summary: Land owned by federal, state, local and tribal governments and by nonprofit conservation organisations, coloured by manager.

layers.name: Townships & Sections
layers.summary: The PLSS township and range grid, filling in with one-mile sections as you zoom in.

layers.name: Quarter-Quarter Sections & Lots
layers.summary: Sections divided into forty-acre quarter-quarters and the government lots surveyed along rivers, lakes and irregular township edges.

layers.name: Parcels
layers.summary: Property lines from county tax maps. An approximation for orientation, not a survey.

layers.name: Land Cover History
layers.summary: What covered the ground each year since 1985: forest, cropland, wetland, developed land. Good for seeing when a place changed.

layers.name: Crop History
layers.summary: Which crop was grown in each field, year by year. Complete from 2008; earlier years cover fewer states.

layers.name: Satellite History
layers.summary: Past satellite imagery of this place, by the date each picture was taken. Worldwide, back to about 2010, with the dates that actually exist here.

layers.name: Historical Topo Maps

layers.summary: Aerial photographs taken by NOAA in the days after hurricanes, floods and fires since 2018. Sharp enough to see individual roofs. Only flights over the place in view appear.

layers.name: VFR Sectional Charts
layers.summary: The FAA's charts for flying by sight: airspace, airports, navaids, obstacles and landmarks. Updated every 56 days. Not for navigation.

layers.name: VFR Terminal Area Charts
layers.summary: Close-up FAA charts of the airspace around the busiest airports, at twice the sectional scale. Updated every 56 days. Not for navigation.

layers.name: IFR Low Altitude Charts
layers.summary: The FAA's instrument charts below 18,000 ft: airways, minimum altitudes, navaids and waypoints. Updated every 56 days. Not for navigation.

layers.name: IFR High Altitude Charts
layers.summary: The FAA's instrument charts from 18,000 ft up: jet routes, navaids and control centre boundaries. Updated every 56 days. Not for navigation.

layers.name: European VFR Charts
layers.summary: Community-made VFR charts for much of Europe: airspace, aerodromes, navaids and reporting points. Updated each AIRAC cycle. Not for navigation.

ar-gis.name: Arkansas GIS Office
ar-gis.summary: The state agency that publishes Arkansas's aerial imagery archive, one statewide service per flight.

blm.name: Bureau of Land Management
blm.summary: The Department of the Interior agency that keeps the cadastral survey records of the Public Land Survey System and publishes them as the national CadNSDI dataset.

census.name: United States Census Bureau
census.summary: Maintains the TIGER geographic database, the national record of legal and statistical boundaries from states down to school and legislative districts.

ct-eco.name: Connecticut Environmental Conditions Online
ct-eco.summary: A partnership of the Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection and the University of Connecticut, publishing the state's aerial imagery.

dc-gis.name: District of Columbia Office of the Chief Technology Officer
dc-gis.summary: Publishes the District's orthophotography, from 1927 to the current flight.

de-firstmap.name: Delaware FirstMap
de-firstmap.summary: Delaware's state geospatial data exchange, which serves statewide imagery of Delaware from 1926 on.

eox.name: EOX IT Services GmbH
eox.summary: Publisher of Sentinel-2 cloudless, a global cloud-free satellite mosaic derived from ESA Copernicus imagery.

esri.name: Esri
esri.summary: Hosts the USGS Historical Topographic Map Collection as a publicly readable image service, and publishes World Imagery Wayback, the archive of past versions of its satellite basemap.

faa.name: Federal Aviation Administration
faa.summary: The U.S. aviation regulator. Its Aeronautical Information Services office publishes the official VFR and IFR charts and the national airspace, airport and navaid data, renewed every 56 days.

fl-dep.name: Florida Department of Environmental Protection
fl-dep.summary: Serves the Florida Department of Transportation's aerial photography and older countywide photographs through MapDirect.

ga-clearinghouse.name: Georgia GIS Clearinghouse
ga-clearinghouse.summary: The state's geospatial clearinghouse, run by the University of Georgia's ITOS, which serves Georgia's imagery from 1993 to 2010.

gebco.name: General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans
gebco.summary: An international programme, operating under IHO and IOC, that publishes the authoritative global bathymetric grid.

il-isgs.name: Illinois State Geological Survey
il-isgs.summary: Runs the Illinois Geospatial Data Clearinghouse, which serves the state's orthophotography from 1993 on.

in-gio.name: Indiana Geographic Information Office
in-gio.summary: The state office that publishes Indiana's orthoimagery under a CC0 dedication.

inside-idaho.name: INSIDE Idaho, University of Idaho Library
inside-idaho.summary: Idaho's geospatial data clearinghouse, run by the University of Idaho Library, which serves the state's NAIP archive.

iowa-state-gis.name: Iowa State University Geographic Information Systems Facility
iowa-state-gis.summary: Hosts Iowa's statewide orthoimagery archive, including scanned aerial photography from the 1930s onward.

ks-dasc.name: Kansas Data Access and Support Center
ks-dasc.summary: Kansas's state geospatial data centre, whose imagery is served by the Kansas Geological Survey.

ky-dgi.name: Kentucky Division of Geographic Information
ky-dgi.summary: Runs KyFromAbove, which publishes Kentucky's imagery in the public domain.

lsu-atlas.name: LSU Atlas, Louisiana State University
lsu-atlas.summary: Louisiana State University's statewide GIS archive, publishing the state's orthophotography from 1998 on.

macrostrat.name: Macrostrat
macrostrat.summary: A geological data platform maintained at the University of Wisconsin–Madison that harmonises regional geologic maps into a single queryable stratigraphic model.

mapzen-terrain.name: Mapzen / AWS Open Data
mapzen-terrain.summary: A global terrain-RGB elevation tile set aggregated from SRTM, 3DEP, GMTED and other public sources, hosted on the AWS Open Data registry.

massgis.name: Massachusetts Bureau of Geographic Information
massgis.summary: Massachusetts' statewide GIS agency, publishing historical black-and-white orthophotography and a modern imagery series.

md-imap.name: Maryland Department of Information Technology, MD iMAP
md-imap.summary: Maryland's state geospatial portal, which serves the state's six-inch imagery and its NAIP archive.

mi-dtmb.name: State of Michigan Department of Technology, Management and Budget
mi-dtmb.summary: Runs the Michigan Imagery Solution, which serves the state's aerial imagery from 1998 on.

mn-dnr.name: Minnesota Department of Natural Resources
mn-dnr.summary: Runs the most extensive inland lake bathymetric survey programme in the United States, publishing measured depth contours and lake-bed elevation models for thousands of Minnesota lakes.

mngeo.name: Minnesota IT Services Geospatial Information Office
mngeo.summary: Minnesota's state geospatial office, which serves the state's aerial imagery archive.

mo-msdis.name: Missouri Spatial Data Information Service
mo-msdis.summary: The University of Missouri's state geospatial service, publishing Missouri's imagery from 1990 on.

ms-maris.name: MARIS Technical Center
ms-maris.summary: Mississippi's state geospatial clearinghouse, run for the state's universities.

mt-msl.name: Montana State Library
mt-msl.summary: Coordinates the Montana Spatial Data Infrastructure and serves the state's aerial imagery.

nasa.name: National Aeronautics and Space Administration
nasa.summary: Publishes daily satellite imagery of the whole Earth since 2000 through its Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS).

nc-onemap.name: North Carolina Center for Geographic Information and Analysis
nc-onemap.summary: North Carolina's statewide GIS clearinghouse, publishing a near-continuous annual orthoimagery series.

nd-gis.name: North Dakota GIS Hub
nd-gis.summary: North Dakota's statewide geospatial clearinghouse, publishing the state's aerial imagery archive from the late 1950s and lake depth contours surveyed by the state Game and Fish Department.

nh-granit.name: NH GRANIT, University of New Hampshire
nh-granit.summary: New Hampshire's statewide GIS clearinghouse, run by the University of New Hampshire's Earth Systems Research Center.

nj-ogis.name: New Jersey Office of Information Technology, Office of GIS
nj-ogis.summary: Publishes New Jersey's imagery archive, from a 1920 survey of the Atlantic coast to the current statewide flight.

noaa.name: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
noaa.summary: U.S. agency for oceanic and atmospheric science. Its National Centers for Environmental Information publish multibeam bathymetry and global relief models, and its National Geodetic Survey flies the coast after major storms.

ny-its.name: New York State Office of Information Technology Services, Geospatial Services
ny-its.summary: Runs New York's orthoimagery programme, which flies a block of the state each year.

nyc-oti.name: New York City Office of Technology and Innovation
nyc-oti.summary: Publishes the city's aerial photographs, from a 1924 mosaic to the current flight, under CC BY 4.0.

ofma.name: open flightmaps association
ofma.summary: A non-profit association in Austria whose volunteers keep an open database of aeronautical data for the European regions they cover, and render it as VFR charts.

oh-dnr.name: Ohio Department of Natural Resources
oh-dnr.summary: Publishes surveyed depth contours for Ohio's inland lakes and reservoirs through its Division of Wildlife, and a separate bathymetric survey of Lake Erie.

ok-ogi.name: Oklahoma Office of Geographic Information
ok-ogi.summary: Oklahoma's state geospatial office, serving every NAIP flight over the state since 2008.

openfreemap.name: OpenFreeMap
openfreemap.summary: Free hosting of OpenStreetMap-derived vector tiles with no API key or usage limits.

oregon-explorer.name: Oregon Explorer / Oregon State University
oregon-explorer.summary: Publishes Oregon's statewide imagery archive including historical NAIP acquisitions.

pasda.name: Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access
pasda.summary: Pennsylvania's official public geospatial information clearinghouse, hosted at Penn State.

regrid.name: Regrid
regrid.summary: A commercial aggregator that normalises county tax-parcel data into a nationwide layer, and publishes its parcel outlines as a free tile service through ArcGIS Living Atlas.

ri-rigis.name: RIGIS, University of Rhode Island Environmental Data Center
ri-rigis.summary: Rhode Island's geographic information system, run with the University of Rhode Island, publishing statewide imagery from 1939 on.

tx-gio.name: Texas Geographic Information Office
tx-gio.summary: The state office (formerly TNRIS) that serves Texas's aerial imagery archive, from 1981 high-altitude photography on.

usda.name: United States Department of Agriculture
usda.summary: Publisher of the National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP) and, through the National Agricultural Statistics Service, the Cropland Data Layer.

usfws.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
usfws.summary: Publisher of the National Wetlands Inventory.

usgs.name: United States Geological Survey
usgs.summary: The science bureau of the U.S. Department of the Interior and the publisher of The National Map, 3DEP elevation, the National Hydrography Dataset and the Historical Topographic Map Collection.

va-vgin.name: Virginia Geographic Information Network
va-vgin.summary: Runs the Virginia Base Mapping Program, which has flown part of the Commonwealth almost every year since 2002.

vt-vcgi.name: Vermont Center for Geographic Information
vt-vcgi.summary: Vermont's state geospatial office, which serves the state's orthophotography from the 1970s Vermont Mapping Program on.

wa-tech.name: Washington Technology Solutions, Geospatial Program
wa-tech.summary: Washington's state geospatial programme, which serves statewide aerial imagery from 1989 on.

wi-dnr.name: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources
wi-dnr.summary: Publishes Wisconsin's statewide imagery programme, including scanned 1930s aerial photography georeferenced from State Cartographer's Office originals.

wv-gistc.name: West Virginia GIS Technical Center
wv-gistc.summary: West Virginia University's state GIS centre, which serves the statewide 2003 orthophotography and every NAIP flight since.

wy-deq.name: Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality
wy-deq.summary: Serves statewide aerial imagery of Wyoming from 1994 to 2015.
